about: The caves' look (the Undermere, first person): one look for every cave file, read by meshy_cave_build.py. The exposure, the fog and wdi_baked are the network's and go into every cave's Area extras exactly as written here (contract docs/walk-areas.md, world.cave_look). Colours are sRGB hex. Light kinds: a lamp only at a gate (lamp group), the night sky through a mouth (sky group), dim fill lights in the chambers and the wide passages (fill group), and AO.
status: P0 prototype (2026-11-21): not frozen. E, the scene exposure the light is graded at, is the Swallow's lamp pool at its first full bake (384 samples, 2026-11-21): every cave is graded at it, so the light matches across seams

lamp.about_emit: COLOR_0-free emitters (linear, at most 1): the glass shows #F0B481 and the lamp's iron cap, base and bracket #382C22 through the viewer's exposure and AgX (route 1: the P0 glass at glass_display read as a flat grey box)

fill.about_route2: route 2: a chamber of min_area_m2 or more also gets a ring of low lights near its walls (the Well Dome read flat under one light; the Great Dome too), and a climb face of min_height_m or more a low light beside its foot, so the face is lit across

lantern.about: the walker carries a lantern in the caves (apps/walk src/lantern.ts), so the baked fill is a fifth of route 3's (weights.fill; the ink floor, not the fill, sets most rock's level: see ink_lift.dark_gain); placed lamps (the gates' lamps) keep their weight (keep_lamps: the lamp pool rule's dimming, route 1's, is reported but not applied; the highlights' easing caps the pool), and the ink floor still holds the darkest texel. The report compares the display of the texels farther than lamp_reach_m from every placed lamp with route 3's look (every weight 1, form route3_form) on the same bake

lightmap.about: the shell's light is baked into one lightmap page per cave file (meshy_cave_lightmap.py: texels per metre by its rule, at most 32), saved as WebP at quality (100 is lossless) and exported as each shell material's emissiveTexture on TEXCOORD_1 with extras wdi_lightmap (docs/walk-areas.md, section 4, a cave's lightmap)

ink_lift.about: the ink floor holds each texel's darkest kept scan texel at ink (dark_percentile, after the scan's dark tail is lifted towards texture_lift of its mean); dark_gain (1.4) holds the texel dark_gain times lighter than the darkest at that floor, so the bake sits that much darker (the realism pass: the baked level away from the lamps is about 0.36 of route 3's as the screen gives it, from 0.58): the darkest few texels are then under the ink in the file, and the viewer clamps every pixel of a cave to the ink in luminance (apps/walk lantern.ts) and keeps it from lilac; texture_mean_max (0.22) caps a scan's mean linear luminance, so the pale scans (the flowstone, the breakdown, the gypsum) are not twice as bright as the limestone under the lantern; its multiplier is 1 + form x the AO term x (form_base + (1 - form_base) x s), s = x / (1 + x), x the bake over shape_ref x the floor's light (meshy_cave_build.floor_shape), so the floor carries the bake's shape and rock far from every light sits on the bare floor; the darkest-texel ratio is relaxed across the materials' edges by at most exp(floor_blend_per_m) a metre (meshy_cave_lightmap.relax_floor), so the light does not step where two scans meet

hot.about: display luminance over knee is eased towards max; timber (the guards' rails and the gates' railway timbers, creosoted) has its own lower knee and max, as the grille has its iron cap (route 1 fix: the Cutting Gate's centre post 0.3 m under the lamp read as a cream bar)

iron_display.about: a gate's grille: display luminance held between ink_margin x the ink and cap, its hue the iron's grey warmed towards the lamp's colour by up to warm where the lamp gives the light (route 1: the P0 bars read cream in a saturated blue frame)
